app.title: PALERMO
setup.notEnoughMessage: You need at least {min} players with the current settings.
settings.title: Optional Roles
settings.loversDesc: Two linked players — if one dies, both die
role.hiddenKiller.name: Hidden Killer
role.hiddenKiller.desc: You are a Killer. Coordinate with your partner each night to eliminate players. Stay hidden.
role.revealedKiller.name: Revealed Killer
role.revealedKiller.desc: You are a Killer. The Detective knows your identity. Work with the Hidden Killer to eliminate everyone.
role.detective.name: Detective
role.detective.desc: You know the Revealed Killer's identity. Guide the group to find the Hidden Killer. Protect your information.
role.citizen.name: Citizen
role.citizen.desc: You have no special ability. Use your instincts to find the killers. Trust no one.
role.doctor.name: Doctor
role.doctor.desc: Each night, choose one player to save. If they are the killers' target, the kill fails.
role.informant.name: Informant
role.informant.desc: Each night, you receive limited information. Use it wisely to help the group.
reveal.loverNote:
You are also a Lover.
If your partner dies, you die too.
narration.nightFalls:
Night falls on Palermo.
Everyone close your eyes.
narration.killersWake:
Hidden Killer and Revealed Killer,
open your eyes and meet each other.
narration.detectiveWake:
Revealed Killer, raise your hand.
Detective, open your eyes.
narration.loversWake:
Lovers, open your eyes
and find each other.
narration.dawnBreaks:
Dawn breaks.
Everyone open your eyes.
narration.nightAgain:
Night falls again.
Everyone close your eyes.
narration.killersChoose:
Killers, whisper your target
to the messenger.
narration.doctorWake:
Doctor, open your eyes.
Choose someone to save.
narration.whoWasKilled: Who was killed during the night?
narration.killBlocked:
The kill was blocked.
No one died tonight.
vote.title: Who is eliminated?
vote.subtitle: Tap + to add votes for each player
night.selectVictim: Select the victim, or confirm no one died
